issues.description: The problem statement (Aufgabe 03) requires the names and type (Art) of all Schwimmbäder plus the name and all Einwohnerzahlen of the associated Gemeinden. The solution query, however, selects Schwimmbad.id instead of Schwimmbad.name, so it does not return the requested Schwimmbad names. This mismatch between the task description and the provided solution can confuse students about which column to select and leads to an incorrect reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query to select the Schwimmbad name instead of its id. For example, change 'SELECT Schwimmbad.id, Schwimmbad.art as Art, ...' to 'SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art as Art, ...' so the solution matches the problem statement.
